selection: Purposive correctness-focused sample; 9 keyword queries plus user-provided seeds. No exhaustive/random sampling claim.
counting: One record per independent defect or tightly related root-cause family. Split FlagGems#5234 and vLLM#52576 into two. Split supplemental Unsloth#13830 into two. Collapse FlagGems#7539 into #6978; collapse related issue/fix/backport/vendor copies. V62697 retains only unresolved Triton reader pattern A; HIP writer pattern B excluded.
evidence_A: Read report and key production-code PR diff. Does not imply merged, independent GPU reproduction, or verified correctness of the fix.
evidence_B: Read relevant issue narrative, reproduction/log/IR sections or in-body code fragments; no separate production-fix diff reviewed. Triton compiler issue comments also read.
conditional_tag: At least one explicit shape/autotune/layout trigger in report; not proof that this is the complete or exclusive failure condition. operator_parameter/data/dtype/backend alone are not included.
local_verification: CPU arithmetic only for pdist threshold, grid coverage, grid product, signed wrap, padding softcap and group-scale illustration.
limitations: Open PRs and reporter claims retained with evidence labels
Many related implementations/authors; records are not independent random observations
Hypothesized verifier applicability is not measured detection or proof coverage
No root cause inferred solely from repository name
Absence of a shape tag does not establish shape independence
